name: UK inflation & rates
summary: UK CPI rose to 3.6% in October from 3.5%; Bank Rate raised to 4% in November with a December rise priced
state: The ONS reported on 18 Nov that CPI rose 3.6% in the 12 months to October, up from 3.5%, with motor fuels the largest upward driver (ONS; ITV News). That sits inside the 2.5–4.0% Watch band. The Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4% in November, its first rise since 2023, reversing its earlier cutting course (Bank of England).
for_you: Households on variable or soon-to-renew mortgages and borrowers are most exposed to higher rates; savers see higher returns. Prices for fuel and essentials are rising faster than earlier in the year.
rubric_hit: Watch: CPI 3.6% within 2.5–4.0% band, and BoE reversed course with a rise to 4%

rubric.alert: CPI > 4.0%, or an emergency BoE move.
